title: djazair.dev Project Hub registry
description: projects.yml: one entry per listed project (PRD HUB-01). Language, licence and activity are read from GitHub.

projects.description: The listed projects. Add yours at the end.

repository.description: Write the GitHub repository as owner/name, for example djazairdev/djazair.dev.

category.description: app: something people use; library: code other programs use; tool: something developers use; dataset: data.

tags.description: One to five tags saying how the project relates to Algeria.

maintainer_pledge.description: Write true: the maintainers pledge to reply to newcomer pull requests within 7 days.

added.description: The date you add the entry, written YYYY-MM-DD.

x-unknown.language: The language is read from GitHub, so it isn’t stored here: remove this line.
x-unknown.languages: Languages are read from GitHub, so they aren’t stored here: remove this line.
x-unknown.licence: The licence is read from GitHub, so it isn’t stored here: remove this line.
x-unknown.license: The licence is read from GitHub, so it isn’t stored here: remove this line.
x-unknown.description: The description is read from GitHub, so it isn’t stored here: remove this line.
x-unknown.stars: Stars are read from GitHub, so they aren’t stored here: remove this line.
x-unknown.activity: Activity is read from GitHub, so it isn’t stored here: remove this line.
x-unknown.url: Write the repository as owner/name in repository: instead.

tag.description: Pick tags from the list in CONTRIBUTING.md; if none fits, propose a new one in your pull request.
